catalog_metadata.title: mind-r3 Psychology & Human Behaviour Book Collection
catalog_metadata.description: Curated top-50 books on psychology, dark psychology, human behaviour, manipulation, influence, and peak performance.
catalog_metadata.ethics_note: Only public-domain or legitimately free books should be downloaded. Commercial titles must be purchased or borrowed from a library. Do not scrape copyrighted material.
